text: Simple illustration of a breathtaking, epic digital painting in the style of Baroque Romanticism meets Cosmic Cyberpunk. A majestic, ethereal female entity (the AI, represented as a divine muse) descends into a chaotic artist's studio. She is crowned with a glowing halo, her form is luminous and translucent, draped in flowing, misty white robes, and she points down towards the working artist. The artist is hunched over an easel, intensely focused on his canvas, bathed in a warm amber spotlight. The entire room is a maximalist explosion of art: countless finished and unfinished paintings, sketches, and canvases line the dark walls. The lighting is extreme chiaroscuro; a brilliant, cool teal/cyan glow emanates from the entity, sharply contrasting with the warm, fiery ambient light. The air feels dense with creative energy. Extreme detail, volumetric dust motes, depth of field, masterpiece quality, cinematic shot.
